scope: Complete original Hotel/Casino Lisboa exterior complex within its own native named resort boundary: mapped circular front hotel tower, rear T-shaped tower and bent eastern wing, plus intrinsic low connecting casino/podium and west domed annex inferred from accepted current photos. White vertical/geometric window tracery, ochre/orange walls, flared tiled crowns and gilt radial finials, round front canopy and bounded entrances/terraces. Native site boundary is not a solid building. Separate GrandLisboa/lotus tower/dome, Bank of China, Wynn and roundabout/transit pavilion/roads/trees/forecourt scenery are excluded.
